title: Host Fees Accounting Note: Assessment and Refund of the Host Service Fee
content:
# Host Accounts — The Host Service Fee

## Assessment

The host service fee is assessed once per stay, at check-in, on the host-fee base — the nightly subtotal, cleaning fee, pet fee total and extra-guest fee total of the stay as booked or as last altered — and is withheld from the host's earnings. The fee is the host-fee base multiplied by the percentage that applies, divided by 100, rounded to the cent.

## Which percentage applies

| The stay's fee structure | The fee structure of the account's tier | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| Split fee | Host-only fee | The split-fee host percentage of the tier |
| Host-only fee | Split fee | The default host-only percentage of the tier |
| Same as the tier's | Same as the stay's | *Retired wording — see the note below* |

**Retired wording.** The clause "the percentage is the host service fee percentage of the account's tier when the stay's fee structure equals the tier's fee structure" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis of Host Accounts.

## One assessment per stay

The host service fee for a stay is assessed only once. A stay that already shows a host service fee assessment in the account's records is not assessed again.

## Refunds of the fee

When guest refunds funded by the host are issued after the payout release, the host service fee is refunded at the same percentage on the refunded host-funded amount, and the total refunded never exceeds the fee assessed on the stay.

## Cancelled stays

- A stay cancelled by the guest before check-in is assessed on the host-funded amount the guest did not get back, when that amount is released on the original check-in schedule.
- A stay cancelled by the host is never assessed.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

1. A split-fee stay is assessed while the account's tier carries a host-only fee whose split-fee host percentage is 3.00%. Host-fee base USD 1240.00: the fee is USD 1240.00 multiplied by 3.00, divided by 100, which is USD 37.20.
2. That fee was USD 37.20 at 3.00%. After the payout release the host funds a guest refund of USD 400.00: the fee refunded is USD 400.00 at 3.00%, which is USD 12.00. Later host-funded refunds on the same stay are refunded the same way until the refunds of the fee reach USD 37.20 in total, and never beyond it.
3. A guest cancels before check-in and USD 250.00 of host-funded amount is not returned to the guest and is released on the original check-in schedule: the fee is assessed on USD 250.00.

superseded_clauses: The percentage is host_service_fee_pct of the account's tier when the stay's fee_structure equals the tier's fee_structure
